name: Mochida Satoshi
source:
Likes: School
Dislikes: The dark, confined spaces, and ghost stories
Hobbies: Collecting CDs

A student in Kisaragi Academy Senior High class 2-9. Fairly average, but popular. Known for being both kind and cowardly in equal measure.
Despite his timidness, he's very personable and open, which complements his general sensitivity toward others to make him a natural leader.
The one person even to challenge that leadership is [url=/c6500]Naomi[/url] -- who is, consequently, the only person to whom Satoshi regularly defers judgement.

[From Corpse Party Character Introductions]
